definitions.uncertain: Excluded from TP/FP/TN/FN; counts toward response coverage, not selective coverage.
definitions.missing: Not counted as UNCERTAIN; excluded from classification metrics, reduces both coverages.
definitions.tier3_f1: Tier-3 hallucinated entries plus ALL valid entries, matching upstream per_tier_metrics.
definitions.per_type: Each hallucination type plus ALL valid inputs for FP/FPR/F1. Type total/uncertain/all-input detection use only that type.
definitions.zero_denominator: 0, as in upstream ConfusionMatrix; inspect counts when a stratum has no answers.
definitions.all_input_detection: TP / all selected hallucinated inputs, including uncertain and missing.
definitions.confidence: Fixed heuristic P(predicted label correct), not calibrated probabilities.
